source.title: On Some Open Problems about P-Spaces, Strongly Quasi Baire Spaces and Choice

trace.notes: Normalized URL input as zbMATH resolver id 7783589. The zbMATH REST API resolved the record as Eleftherios Tachtsis, 'On some open problems about P-spaces, strongly quasi Baire spaces and choice,' Results in Mathematics 79, Paper No. 19 (2024), DOI 10.1007/s00025-023-02049-4. This metadata was used only for identity and title recovery, not as extraction evidence.

Direct local fetch of https://zbmath.org/7783589 returned a Cloudflare challenge/HTTP 403, so the zbMATH landing page was treated as a blocked resolver. The API record exposed only bibliographic metadata, review text, references, and a DOI link; it did not contain the article's full problem statements.

Identifier-specific recovery followed the DOI to Springer Nature Link and tried the canonical article and PDF URLs. The DOI chain identified the exact Springer article, but the available tool fetches could not recover a readable article body or PDF for extraction; exact Springer article/PDF opens returned no readable primary-source artifact.

Bounded exact-work search used the exact title, DOI, and PDF variants. The inspected candidates were rejected: Springer search results exposed only related-article pages and snippets, Tachtsis's personal publications page listed the work but no full text, and ResearchGate profile/search entries showed metadata/abstract text but the exact article page/full text was not accessible through the available tools. No candidate provided a readable exact-work PDF or full HTML source containing the problem statements.

Input could not be normalized to a readable PDF or HTML full-text source. Failure modes: blocked_or_challenged, network_or_dns_failure, and metadata_only. No extraction was performed because recovered visible sources were resolver metadata, author publication lists, search snippets, abstracts, or related Springer pages rather than the exact article's readable full text.
Saved exact JSON output to outputs/parse-paper/zbmath-7783589.json and outputs/latest.json.
